test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 73

questions.question: If the eight-digit number 60307A96 is completely divisible by 264, then the smallest digit in place of A will be:
The average of 13 numbers is 7. If each of these numbers is multiplied by 7, then what will be the new average?
X and Y can run 400 metres in 44 seconds and 50 seconds, respectively. How far is Y from the finishing line when X reaches it?

A can do a piece of work alone in 10 days. He starts work alone but leaves after 4 days. From the fifth day, B works alone for 9 days to complete the remaining work. How long would have A and B, working together, needed to complete the entire work?
At what rate (in percentage) per year will a sum of money double itself in 25 years on simple interest?
Alka’s monthly salary is 25% more than that of Bhawna, and Bhawna’s monthly salary is 8% more than that of Champa. If Champa’s monthly salary is ₹15,000, then what is the monthly salary of Alka?
Virender bought an article for ₹318 and sold it to Rupali at a loss of 12%. With this amount, Virender bought another article and sold it at a gain of 50%. What is Virender’s overall gain percentage?
If p is a prime number such that 2p−1 is a square number, then find the smallest value of p  out of 31, 59, 61 and 71.

A, B and C started a business jointly investing ₹11.9 lakh, ₹13.6 lakh and ₹8.5 lakh, respectively. The profit earned by them in the business at the end of 3 years was ₹30 lakh. What will be half of B’s share in the profit?

A shopkeeper buys 80 books for the marked price of 76 books from a wholesaler. If he sells these books by giving a discount of 1% on the original marked price, then what is his profit percentage? (Round off your answer to two decimal places.)
The average of 13 numbers is 7. If each number is multiplied by 9, then what will the new average be?
A mobile phone’s value decreased from ₹64,000 to ₹27,000 over a period of 3 years. Determine the annual rate of depreciation, if it is compounded yearly.
The average of 13 numbers is 7. If each number is multiplied by 6, then what will be the new average?
The mean proportional of two numbers is 10 and their third proportional is 80. Find the two numbers.

Pipes A and B can fill an empty tank in 15 hours and 10 hours, respectively. Both were opened at the same time. After 2 hours, it was noticed that, by mistake, the waste pipe was also opened along with pipes A and B. The waste pipe was immediately closed. The tank was filled in a total of 6 hours and 24 minutes. How much time will it take for the waste pipe to empty the completely filled tank?

Find the average annual percentage increase (round off to two decimal places) in the population of a country over the last decade, if the population increased from 5,25,000 to 8,75,500 during that period.
An article is sold for ₹2,000 and the profit earned on it is triple the loss incurred when the same article is sold for ₹400. Find the selling price for making 50% profit.
The product of two numbers is 416 and their L.C.M. is 104. Find their H.C.F.
A trader gains 79% after selling an item at 12% discount on the printed price. What is the ratio of the cost price and the printed price of the item?

The average age of 12 members of a family is 60 years. If the youngest member is 5 years old, what was the average age (in years) of the family members just before the birth of the youngest member?1511
